test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: From which budget year in India was the Railway budget merged with the Union budget and was not presented separately?
solution:
The correct answer is__ **2017 - 18**.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The government of India approved the merger of Railway Budget with the General Budget on **September 21. 2016. **
 
• The Government has decided to merge Rail Budget with the Union Budget from **budget year 2017-18. **
 
• The Committee headed by **Shri Bibek Debroy**, Member, NITI Aayog, and a separate paper on "**Dispensing with the Railway Budget**" by Shri Bibek Debroy and Shri Kishore Desai served as the foundation for the merger of the railway budget with the general budget.
 
• A committee made up of members from the** Ministries of Finance and Railways** looked at the relevant issues and worked out the procedural specifics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Following is a general list of the** key characteristics **of mergers and the advantages that are likely to result from them:

 
 
• **Ministry of Railways** will continue to operate as a department-run business venture.
 
• Railways shall have their own** Statement of Budget Estimates and Grant Request.**
 
• The** Ministry of Finance** will compile and propose to Parliament a single Appropriation Bill that includes the estimates for Railways, and the Ministry of Finance will manage all related legislative activities.
 
• Railways shall be excluded from making dividend payments to **General Revenues**, and their capital-at-charge will be eliminated.
 
• The Ministry of Finance will give the Ministry of Railways **gross budgetary support **to help cover some of its capital expenses.
 
• **Railways** may continue to finance their capital expenditures by using extra-budgetary resources to get resources from the market.
 
• The publication of a unified budget will assist in providing a comprehensive picture of the **government's financial situation.**
 
• Planning for multimodal transportation involving roads, railroads, and inland waterways would be made easier by the merger of the Rail Budget with the Union Budget.
 
• It will give the** Ministry of Finance** more flexibility during the mid-year review to better allocate resources, etc.
